lines.en: label harukaspring4:
scene harukarincafetalk1

It was another night at Koi Cafe, which meant it was another chance for Haruka Hamasaki to sit down, relax, and be proud of herself for managing to create such a successful business in such a weird town.
lines.zh: 又是 Koi Cafe 的一个夜晚，这意味着 Haruka Hamasaki 又有一次机会坐下来、放松一下，并为自己在这么古怪的小镇上创出这么成功的一门生意而自豪。

lines.en: Yet, as she glanced down at a sheet of paper with different types of milk splayed across it like a prostitute on a cocaine-lined glass table, she had something else on her mind.
lines.zh: 然而，当她低头看向那张印着各类牛奶的纸——它们摊开的姿势，活像个趴在铺满可卡因的玻璃桌上的妓女——她脑子里想的却是别的事。

lines.en: {size=-3}You see, she was thinking about friendship. About ways to improve herself mentally so that she doesn’t wind up on the wrong side of the tracks again before being struck at full speed by a DC tilting EMU E353 Series train.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}你瞧，她在想的是友谊。想的是怎么在精神上提升自己，好让自己别再走到铁轨的错误那一侧、然后被一列直流摆式 EMU E353 系列车全速撞上。{/size}

lines.en: Yes, it would truly suck to be killed by one of 213 aluminum alloy-bodied vehicles constructed between 2015 and 2019 with a car length of 20,000 (21,000 on the ends) and a maximum speed of 130 kmph.
lines.zh: 是啊，要是被 2015 至 2019 年间制造的 213 辆铝合金车体车辆中的一辆撞死，那可真够糟的——车长 20,000（头尾车 21,000），最高时速 130 公里。

lines.en: {size=-3}She’d much rather be one of the 686 people riding it at maximum capacity from Shinjuku to Kōfu as a part of the limited express Kaiji service, complete with free passenger Wifi, trolley service, and excellent views of Mt. Fuji.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}她反倒宁愿成为满员 686 名乘客中的一员，搭乘特急「甲斐路」从新宿前往甲府，享受免费车载 Wifi、推车服务，以及富士山的绝佳景致。{/size}

lines.en: Was she thinking about it {i}this{/i} specifically, though? No. This is just a metaphor. A long one. In fact, Haruka had only taken such a train one time in her life — on a trip to see her aunt and uncle in Yamanashi.
lines.zh: 不过，她真是在想{i}这么{/i}具体的事吗？不是。这只是个比喻。一个很长的比喻。事实上，Haruka 这辈子只坐过一次那种列车——去山梨看她的叔叔婶婶。

lines.en: They didn’t matter right now, though. Not just because they weren’t on her mind, but because they {i}had{/i} been struck by a DC tilting EMU E353 Series train over a decade ago.
lines.zh: 不过他们现在不重要。不只是因为他们不在她心上，而是因为他们{i}确实{/i}在十多年前被一列直流摆式 EMU E353 系列车撞过。

lines.en: Hey, have you ever noticed how the bass line in this song sounds like a beating heart?
lines.zh: 嘿，你有没有注意到，这首歌的贝斯线听起来像心跳？

lines.en: Anyway, Haruka. Rin. Two girls in one place — the place that they worked.
lines.zh: 总之。Haruka。Rin。两个女孩在同一个地方——她们工作的地方。

lines.en: No trains. No customers (they were closed right now). Just milk and a mountain of problems that wouldn’t be able to drink that milk because they are problems and problems don’t have mouths.
lines.zh: 没有列车。没有客人（这会儿他们打烊了）。只有牛奶，以及堆积如山的问题——那些问题可喝不了牛奶，因为问题是问题，问题没有嘴。

lines.en: Seriously, though — what if this song is alive?
lines.zh: 不过说真的——万一这首歌是活的呢？

lines.en: : Rin. Try to push skim milk over the next few days. I ordered too much of it and I don’t want it to go bad.
lines.zh: : Rin。接下来几天尽量推脱脂牛奶吧。我订太多了，不想让它坏掉。

lines.en: : You didn’t order too much. Kids these days just don’t care about fat intake the way they used to.
lines.zh: : 你才没订多。现在的年轻人就是不像以前那样在乎脂肪摄入了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that was all we talked about when I was growing up. I never paid much attention, though.
lines.zh: : 是，我小时候大家整天聊的就是这个。不过我从没怎么上心。

lines.en: : Well, maybe if you did, your boobs wouldn’t be the size of hot air balloons?
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是你上心了，你的胸部大概就不会有热气球那么大了？

lines.en: : Yeah, I think you’re right. I should round up every other large-breasted millennial and file a class action lawsuit against Big Milk for when our backs all break in ten more years.
lines.zh: : 是，我觉得你说得对。我该把所有大胸的千禧一代都召集起来，等十年后我们的背全断了，一起对「大牛奶」提起集体诉讼。

lines.en: : I bet “Big Milk” is what they called you in high school.
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌，你高中时的外号就是「大牛奶」。

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk2
: Please, no. I’ve gotten enough nicknames from Molly. The last thing I want is for “Big Milk” to catch on.
lines.zh: : 别，求你了。Molly 已经给我起够多外号了。我最不希望的就是「大牛奶」也跟着传开。

lines.en: : With Molly, it’d probably be something more like...{i}Gigantimilk, Envoy of All that Lactates{/i} or something.
lines.zh: : 换成 Molly，大概会起成……{i}Gigantimilk，万乳之使{/i}之类的。

lines.en: : On second thought, I guess Big Milk is fine. I’m going to call you Little Milk, though.
lines.zh: : 再想想，我觉得「大牛奶」也还行。不过我要叫你「小牛奶」。

lines.en: : Aww, we’re like those little ladle constellations. Maybe they’ve been scooping up milk this entire time and Neil deGrasse Tyson just hasn’t figured it out yet.
lines.zh: : 呜哇，我们就像那些小勺子星座。也许它们一直都在舀牛奶，只是 Neil deGrasse Tyson 还没弄明白而已。

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk3
: Yeah, maybe. You almost done over there? You were supposed to clock out ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 是，也许吧。你那边快好了吗？你十分钟前就该打卡下班了。

lines.en: : Rin? You okay?
lines.zh: : Rin？你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! And...I’m done. I’ve {i}been{/i} done, actually. But, uhh...
lines.zh: : 好！而且……我做完了。其实我{i}早就{/i}做完了。只是，呃……

lines.en: scene black
: Actually, uhh...let me clock out first. I don’t want to-
lines.zh: : 其实，呃……让我先打个卡。我不想——

lines.en: : Is it depression again? Because I told you I don’t want you forcing yourself to work if-
lines.zh: : 又是抑郁吗？因为我跟你说过，我不希望你硬撑着工作，如果——

lines.en: : No! No, it’s not that...It’s just...
lines.zh: : 不是！不是那个……只是……

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk4
: Well, remember how I told you my mom took my phone away for the foreseeable future?
lines.zh: : 嗯，记得我跟你说过，我妈把我的手机没收了、短期内不会还我吗？

lines.en: : I literally just gave you a raise. I can’t give you another one.
lines.zh: : 我刚给你加了薪。不能再加了。

lines.en: : I don’t need another raise. I need...advice. And I {i}definitely{/i} don’t want to talk to my mom about it since that’s kind of how I got into this mess in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我不需要再加薪。我需要的是……建议。而且我{i}绝对{/i}不想跟我妈谈这个，因为我一开始就是那么惹上这摊麻烦的。

lines.en: : I just...don’t know who else to turn to. And you’re practically a third mom to me at this point, so-
lines.zh: : 我只是……不知道还能找谁。而你现在差不多就像是第三个妈妈了，所以——

lines.en: : Of course. You can ask me anything whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 当然。你什么时候想问我都行。

lines.en: : Okay, but...it’s gonna get graphic.
lines.zh: : 好，不过……会有点露骨。

lines.en: : You can definitely ask me anything whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你真的什么时候想问我都行。

lines.en: : Thennnnn...
lines.zh: : 那那那……

lines.en: : What does it...{i}mean...{/i}when a girl goes down on you?
lines.zh: : 一个女生为你口交，到底……{i}意味着什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk5
: You...made it this far into lesbianism without knowing what that means?
lines.zh: : 你……都在百合这条路上走到这一步了，还不知道那是什么意思？

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk6
: N-No! I obviously know what it means! I just...don’t know what it {i}means!{/i} Do you know what I mean?!
lines.zh: : 不——不是！我当然知道那是什么意思！我只是……不知道它{i}意味着什么{/i}！你懂我的意思吗？！

lines.en: : Like...emotionally?
lines.zh: : 像……情感上的？

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk7
: Yes! That! Like...you would obviously have to {i}like{/i} someone to do that, right? Especially if it was out of nowhere while you were really upset and confused and horny.
lines.zh: : 对！就是那个！就像……你显然得{i}喜欢{/i}那个人才会做那种事吧？尤其是在你又难过又混乱又发骚的时候，突然来那么一下。

lines.en: : I’m almost always upset, confused, and horny.
lines.zh: : 我几乎总是又难过、又混乱、又发骚。

lines.en: : Me too. That’s why we get along so well.
lines.zh: : 我也是。所以我们才这么合得来。

lines.en: : Rin...did...
lines.zh: : Rin……难道……

lines.en: : Did this...actually {i}happen?{/i}
lines.zh: : 这事……真的{i}发生过{/i}？

lines.en: : Will this conversation be able to proceed if I do not answer that question?
lines.zh: : 如果我不回答这个问题，这场对话还能继续吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk8
: Then...{i}yeah.{/i}
: Well that’s great, isn’t it?! Who was it? Sana? I bet it was Sana.
lines.zh: : 那不是很好吗？！是谁？Sana？我打赌是 Sana。

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk9
: It was...Chika.
lines.zh: : 是……Chika。

lines.en: : Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。

lines.en: : Yeaaaaah.
: I...don’t get it, though. That’s awesome, isn’t it? You liked her for years. Shouldn’t you be happy about this?
lines.zh: : 可……我不明白。那很棒啊，不是吗？你喜欢她那么多年了。你不是应该为此高兴吗？

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk10
: Yeah! I definitely should! But I’m still not really sure if it actually {i}meant{/i} something! And what’s even more confusing is that I don’t know if I even {i}want{/i} it to.
lines.zh: : 是！我当然应该！可我还是不确定它到底有没有{i}意义{/i}！更让我混乱的是，我甚至不知道自己{i}想{/i}不想它有。

lines.en: : Why...wouldn’t you want it to?
lines.zh: : 为什么……你不想它有？

lines.en: : Because...
lines.zh: : 因为……

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk11
: Because I...think I...have a crush on Sensei.
lines.zh: : 因为我……觉得我……喜欢上 Sensei 了。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 然后……

lines.en: : And you’re {i}just now{/i} realizing this?
lines.zh: : 而你{i}现在才{/i}意识到？

lines.en: : Apparently.
lines.zh: : 显然是。

lines.en: : You seriously didn’t know?
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道？
: 不知道……

lines.en: : You mean to tell me that {i}all{/i} this time, you {i}really{/i} never wanted to be with him? That you were {i}totally{/i} cool with just bro-ing it up for the rest of your life?
lines.zh: : 你是想告诉我，这{i}整整{/i}一段时间里，你{i}真的{/i}从没想过要和他在一起？你{i}完全{/i}可以就这么当一辈子哥们？

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk12
: Why was it so obvious to everyone but me?...
lines.zh: : 为什么除了我，所有人都看得那么清楚？……

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I...didn’t mean for it sound like I was making fun of you. I just figured you knew that already.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……不是故意听起来像在笑话你。我只是以为你早就知道了。

lines.en: : But yeah...if you’re interested in him now and you’re {i}not{/i} interested in Chika anymore-
lines.zh: : 不过是啊……如果你现在对他有兴趣，而对 Chika 已经{i}没{/i}兴趣了——

lines.en: : I don’t {i}know{/i} what I’m interested in, Haruka. Like, I {i}thought{/i} I was over Chika. But then she decided to fucking go to town on me and now my heart starts freaking out again whenever she’s around.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}知道{/i}自己到底对什么有兴趣，Haruka。就是，我{i}以为{/i}我已经放下 Chika 了。可紧接着她决定他妈的在我身上大展身手，现在只要她在旁边，我的心又开始失控。

lines.en: : But you’re worried it didn’t mean anything to her...and you don’t want to overthink things like you always do.
lines.zh: : 可你担心那对她来说毫无意义……而你又不想像往常那样想太多。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Chika’s...
lines.zh: : Chika 她……

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk13
: She’s seemed...different lately. The Chika I know is, like...super faithful and would never cheat on Sensei since she genuinely believes they’re in a relationship.
lines.zh: : 她最近看起来……不太一样。我认识的那个 Chika，是那种……超级专一、绝对不会背着 Sensei 出轨的人，因为她真心相信他俩在交往。

lines.en: : Oof.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。

lines.en: : But now, all of a sudden, she’s just...{i}okay{/i} with him seeing other girls? Like, she straight up told me she wanted to see the look on my face while he fucks me.
lines.zh: : 可现在，突然之间，她就这么……{i}接受{/i}他去见别的女生了？就像，她直接跟我说，她想看他被他肏的时候我脸上的表情。

lines.en: : Yeah, me too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也一样。

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk14
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Nothing! Uhh...so...so what are you asking me exactly? Just...for my feelings on what Chika did? Or...do you want to know where to go from here? Or...
lines.zh: : 没什么！呃……所以……所以你到底想问我什么？只是……我对 Chika 那件事的看法？还是……你想知道接下来该怎么走？或者……

lines.en: : I’m just not really sure what to do. Chika is clearly the more logical choice here {i}if{/i} she actually likes me. And going out with her wouldn’t get anybody in trouble. But, like...
lines.zh: : 我只是真的不知道该怎么办。{i}如果{/i} Chika 真的喜欢我，那她显然是更合乎逻辑的选择。而且和她在一起也不会害任何人惹上麻烦。可是，就像……

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk15
: I really feel like my heart is pushing me toward Sensei this time. Even {i}with{/i} all of the obstacles that are suddenly being thrown at me.
lines.zh: : 我真的觉得，这一次我的心在把我推向 Sensei。{i}哪怕{/i}有那么多障碍突然朝我砸过来。

lines.en: : Well...there’s your answer then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那答案不就有了。

lines.en: : Really? That easy? You don’t think it’s weird for me to go after an adult instead of a girl my age?
lines.zh: : 真的？这么简单？你不觉得我去追一个成年人、而不是一个同龄的女孩很奇怪？

lines.en: : This isn’t {i}any{/i} adult we’re talking about, Rin. It’s Sensei. You two are already like brother and sister, so you might as well just have sex already.
lines.zh: : 我们说的可不是{i}随便哪个{/i}成年人，Rin。是 Sensei。你们俩本来就亲如兄妹，干脆直接上床得了。

lines.en: : I feel like that sentence would hit a lot differently if we weren’t both only childs...only children? Which one of those is grammatically correct? They both sound wrong.
lines.zh: : 我觉得要不是我们俩都是独生子女，这句话的分量会完全不一样……only childs？还是 only children？哪个语法是对的？两个听着都不对。

lines.en: : I don’t know, but I get what you’re saying. If you’re expecting me to talk you out of pursuing him, though...it’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但我懂你的意思。不过你要是指望我劝你别去追他……那是不可能的。

lines.en: : I feel like it {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应{i}该{/i}劝。

lines.en: : Probably, but the way I look at it is really simple.
lines.zh: : 也许是，但我的看法其实很简单。

lines.en: : You two are {i}clearly{/i} compatible despite the age difference. And I think the fact that you’ve managed to know each other for this long {i}without{/i} hooking up is a testament to that. That’s impressive, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你们俩{i}显然{/i}很合得来，尽管有年龄差。而且我觉得，你们认识这么久却{i}没有{/i}搞在一起，本身就是一种证明。这很了不起，Rin。

lines.en: if harukasex == False:
: But you’ve known him pretty much just as long as me and {i}you{/i} haven’t had sex with him either. Are you saying that {i}you’re{/i} compatible with him too?
lines.zh: : 可你认识他的时间跟我差不多长，而{i}你{/i}也没和他上过床。你是说{i}你{/i}也和他很合得来？

lines.en: : I’m married. You’re not. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 我结婚了。你没有。这不一样。

lines.en: else:
: I guess so. {i}You two{/i} had sex pretty much right after meeting each other.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。{i}你们俩{/i}可是刚认识就上床了。

lines.en: : Yes. I regret nothing and intend to stay his obedient little sex slave forever.
lines.zh: : 对。我一点都不后悔，而且打算永远当他听话的小性奴。

lines.en: : This seems like a weird thing to say while pushing me to go after him.
lines.zh: : 你一边催我去追他，一边说这种话，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : I just want you to be happy, Rin. That’s all I’ve {i}ever{/i} wanted for you. And I just think that {i}he{/i} is what would make you the happiest right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你幸福，Rin。这一直以来就是我{i}唯一{/i}想要的。而我就是觉得，{i}他{/i}才是现在能让你最幸福的人。

lines.en: : Why do you think that, though? Why aren’t you worried about all the potential issues and...{i}competition...{/i}the fact that my mom would fucking {i}kill{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 可你为什么这么想？你就不担心那些潜在的问题，还有……{i}竞争对手{/i}……还有我妈会他妈的{i}杀了我{/i}这件事？

lines.en: : I have known you for a long time, Rin. I’ve seen you at your best, your worst, and everything in between.
lines.zh: : 我认识你很久了，Rin。我见过你最好的样子、最糟的样子，以及中间的所有。

lines.en: : I watched the Chika drama unfold. The Otoha drama and the subsequent Molly drama. The Otoha drama {i}again.{/i} And then every single customer who comes in with dyed hair and a crop top that you fall in love with.
lines.zh: : 我看过 Chika 那场戏上演。Otoha 那场，以及随后的 Molly 那场。Otoha 那场{i}又来一遍{/i}。还有每一个你爱上她们的、染着头发穿着露脐装进店的客人。

lines.en: : I am weak. We all know this.
lines.zh: : 我很软弱。我们都知道。

lines.en: : Yes. But this is the {i}first{/i} time I have ever seen you approach a potential relationship maturely. And that just tells me you’re being extra careful not to fuck it up.
lines.zh: : 是。但这是{i}第一次{/i}我看你成熟地对待一段潜在的关系。而这只告诉我，你在格外小心，不想把它搞砸。

lines.en: scene harukarincafetalk16

: Is Sensei the most politically correct choice? No. Is it something I think you should ask {i}others{/i} for advice on? Definitely not. But that doesn’t change how it’s what I would do if I were in your shoes.
lines.zh: : Sensei 是最政治正确的选择吗？不是。这件事该去问{i}别人{/i}的意见吗？绝对不该。但这改变不了一个事实：如果我站在你的位置，我会这么做。

lines.en: : So...love now...consequences later?
lines.zh: : 所以……先爱了，后果以后再说？

lines.en: : Right.
: And...Chika? What do I do about her?
lines.zh: : 那……Chika 呢？我该怎么对她？

lines.en: : Well, do you think she’s going to try and go down on you again?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你觉得她还会再给你口交吗？

lines.en: : I hope so. That was awesome. Scary and kind of weird, but still awesome.
lines.zh: : 希望会。那感觉棒极了。又吓人又有点奇怪，但还是很棒。

lines.en: : But if you had to choose between her going down on you and having sex with Sensei-
lines.zh: : 但如果非要在她给你口交和跟 Sensei 上床之间选一个——

lines.en: : Western silverback.
lines.zh: : 西部银背大猩猩。

lines.en: : ...What?
: I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 我说了我说的。
